description: WEAPONS & DAMAGE table (printed p.2): the title is lost entirely at extraction, Frag Grenade and Rigging Gun lose their stats to split rows, four SPECIAL entries truncate mid-sentence, and Machine Gun is lifted out of alphabetical order. See docs/rules-extraction-findings.md S27.3.

ARMOR table (printed p.2): all five armor names are dropped, Hazard Suit and Advanced Battle Dress lose their descriptions too, and the SPECIAL column truncates mid-sentence -- losing the Vaccsuit's decompression rule and the Advanced Battle Dress's exoskeletal weave. See docs/rules-extraction-findings.md S27.1.
